data.name: Kesavan
data.gender_notes: Kesavan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kesavan is a combination of two Sanskrit words - 'Kesha' meaning hair and 'Van' meaning protector. The name is derived from Lord Shiva who is known as Keshav or Keshanatha, the protector of hair and the one who has the power to control all the senses. Therefore, Kesavan is a name that represents wisdom, power and loyalty.
data.spiritual_meaning: Kesavan is a divine name that is deeply rooted in Hindu spirituality and symbolizes the power and wisdom of the divine. It is believed that those who bear this name are blessed with the qualities of wisdom, strength and protection, and are able to overcome challenges and obstacles with ease.
data.etymology: Kesavan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Wisdom and Power.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kesavan total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
